patch.value: Prevent symlink cycles during docstring source traversal

collectSourceFiles follows directory symlinks through statSync without remembering canonical paths. A directory link back to an ancestor can recurse until stack exhaustion instead of returning a controlled fail-closed result.
Traversal keys visited directories by real path; Canonicalization failures produce a controlled fail-closed error; A real symlink-cycle regression completes and preserves source coverage
Place a directory symlink beneath the scan root that resolves to the root itself, then run analyzeDocstringCoverage.
Each canonical directory is traversed at most once; cycles terminate deterministically while source files remain covered.
Traversal has no visited set and follows the cycle recursively until runtime failure.
A repository symlink cycle can crash the fleet gate with an uncontrolled stack overflow.
A real directory symlink back to the scan root completes deterministically, scans the authored TypeScript file exactly once, checks its declaration, and reports no false violation.
Each directory is canonicalized through realpathSync under a contextual fail-closed error boundary and traversed only once through a visited set.
Canonical-path traversal guard prevents directory symlink recursion while preserving coverage.
